generated.details: On the middle-plane tabletop at left, two unlabelled, palm-sized architectural finish samples lie separately flat: one oak veneer bonded to a thin backing and one solid pale stone tile with visible thickness.
Beside them, a clear glass paperweight is a small solid dome with a flat base resting directly on the tabletop.
At far upper left, a slim architectural wall sconce has a narrow metal backplate supporting an opal diffuser with a subdued glow.
